independent_references_methodology.reference_a_known_ground_truth_suite: 5 canonical 1280x720 stereo scenes (slanted_planes, occlusion_boundaries, thin_structures, repetitive_and_subpixel, low_texture_surface) with exact analytical ground-truth disparity and non-occluded masks, executed on the native Vulkan GPU pipelines.
independent_references_methodology.reference_b_independent_zncc_epipolar: Estimator-independent localized multi-scale (7x7 + 9x9) epipolar ZNCC subpixel template correspondence reference (bidirectional LR symmetry <= 0.55 px, cross-scale agreement <= 0.65 px) evaluated across all 5 distinct physical ZED 2 frames (record_ordinal 0..4), supplemented by dense 100%-coverage epipolar photometric reprojection error |I_L(y,x) - I_R(y,x-d)|, 5x5 patch ZNCC, and 3x3 local surface planarity across all newly admitted pixels. Neither native SGM nor OpenCV SGBM participates in constructing this reference.
